# Independent primary receipts, 2026-10-15

- https://kafka.apache.org/41/design/design/ retrieved: partition-log ordering and transaction boundary support; key routing alone is not an end-to-end business ordering protocol.
- https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/reference/clients/ retrieved: multiplexed client handling; avoid equating entire server with one thread.
- https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/pubsub/ retrieved: at-most-once delivery and lost-disconnect notification caveat.
- https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/innodb-multi-versioning.html retrieved: secondary-index MVCC can require clustered access despite columns being covered; corrected doc03 absolute.
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9220.html retrieved: HTTP/3 WebSocket bootstrap exists, so TCP-only generalization needs traditional-upgrade scope.

Preparation schedules and priorities are editorial options, not guaranteed hiring or performance results. No new personal work/metric assertion. Redis feature list explicitly depends on installed version/modules; no universal Bloom support certification. No SQL/service execution or production outcome verified.
